1.text: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, N God tha Father, who raised him from tha dead;)
N all tha brothers which r wit me, 2 tha churches of Galatia:
Grace be 2 u N peace from God tha Father, N from our Lord Jesus Christ,
Who gave himself 4 our sins, dat he might deliver us from dis present evil world, according 2 tha will of God N our Father:
2 whom be glory 4 ever N ever. Amen.
I marvel dat y’all r so soon removed from him dat called u in2 tha grace of Christ 2 another gospel:
Which is not another; but there be some dat trouble u, N would pervert tha gospel of Christ.
But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel 2 u than dat which we have preached 2 u, let him be accursed.
As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel 2 u than dat y’all have received, let him be accursed.
4 do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek 2 please men? 4 if I yet pleased men, I should not be tha servant of Christ.
But I certify u, brothers, dat tha gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
4 I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by tha revelation of Jesus Christ.
4 y’all have heard of my conversation in time past in tha Jews’ religion, how dat beyond measure I persecuted tha church of God, N wasted it:
N profited in tha Jews’ religion above many my equals in my own nation, bein more exceedingly zealous of tha traditions of my fathers.
But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, N called me by his grace,
2 reveal his Son in me, dat I might preach him among tha heathen; right away I conferred not wit flesh N blood:
Neither went I up 2 Jerusalem 2 ’em which were apostles before me; but I went in2 Arabia, N returned again 2 Damascus.
Then after three years I went up 2 Jerusalem 2 see Peter, N stayed wit him fifteen days.
But other of tha apostles saw I none, save James tha Lord’s brother.
Now tha things which I write 2 u, look, before God, I lie not.
Afterwards I came in2 tha regions of Syria N Cilicia;
N was unknown by face 2 tha churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
But dey had heard only, dat he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth tha faith which once he destroyed.
N dey glorified God in me.

2.text: Then fourteen years after I went up again 2 Jerusalem wit Barnabas, N took Titus wit me also.
N I went up by revelation, N communicated 2 ’em dat gospel which I preach among tha Gentiles, but privately 2 ’em which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
But neither Titus, who was wit me, bein a Greek, was compelled 2 be circumcised:
N dat because of false brothers unawares brought in, who came in privily 2 spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, dat dey might bring us in2 bondage:
2 whom we gave place by subjection, no, not 4 an hour; dat tha truth of tha gospel might continue wit u.
But of dese who seemed 2 be somewhat, (whatever dey were, it makes no matter 2 me: God accepteth no man’s person:) 4 dey who seemed 2 be somewhat in conference added nothing 2 me:
But contrariwise, when dey saw dat tha gospel of tha uncircumcision was committed 2 me, as tha gospel of tha circumcision was 2 Peter;
(4 he dat wrought effectually in Peter 2 tha apostleship of tha circumcision, tha same was mighty in me toward tha Gentiles:)

N when James, Cephas, N John, who seemed 2 be pillars, perceived tha grace dat was given 2 me, dey gave 2 me N Barnabas tha right hands of fellowship; dat we should go 2 tha heathen, N dey 2 tha circumcision.
Only dey would dat we should remember tha poor; tha same which I also was forward 2 do.
But when Peter was come 2 Antioch, I withstood him 2 tha face, because he was 2 be blamed.
4 before dat certain came from James, he did eat wit tha Gentiles: but when dey were come, he withdrew N separated himself, fearin ’em which were of tha circumcision.
N tha other Jews dissembled likewise wit him; insomuch dat Barnabas also was carried away wit their dissimulation.

But when I saw dat dey walked not uprightly according 2 tha truth of tha gospel, I said 2 Peter before ’em all, If u, bein a Jew, live after tha manner of Gentiles, N not as do tha Jews, why compellest u tha Gentiles 2 live as do tha Jews?
We who r Jews by nature, N not sinners of tha Gentiles,

Knowin dat a man is not justified by tha works of tha law, but by tha faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, dat we might be justified by tha faith of Christ, N not by tha works of tha law: 4 by tha works of tha law shall no flesh be justified.
But if, while we seek 2 be justified by Christ, we ourselves also r found sinners, is therefore Christ tha minister of sin? God forbid.
4 if I build again tha things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
4 I through tha law am dead 2 tha law, dat I might live 2 God.
I am crucified wit Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ lives in me: N tha life which I now live in tha flesh I live by tha faith of tha Son of God, who loved me, N gave himself 4 me.
I do not frustrate tha grace of God: 4 if righteousness come by tha law, then Christ is dead in vain.

3.text: O foolish Galatians, who has bewitched u, dat y’all should not obey tha truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ has been evidently set forth, crucified among u?
Dis only would I learn of u, Received y’all tha Spirit by tha works of tha law, or by tha hearin of faith?
R y’all so foolish? havin begun in tha Spirit, r y’all now made perfect by tha flesh?
Have y’all suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
He therefore dat ministereth 2 u tha Spirit, N works miracles among u, does he it by tha works of tha law, or by tha hearin of faith?
Even as Abraham believed God, N it was accounted 2 him 4 righteousness.
Know y’all therefore dat dey which r of faith, tha same r tha children of Abraham.
N tha scripture, foreseeing dat God would justify tha heathen through faith, preached before tha gospel 2 Abraham, sayin, In u shall all nations be blessed.
So then dey which be of faith r blessed wit faithful Abraham.
4 as many as r of tha works of tha law r under tha curse: 4 it is written, Cursed is every one dat continueth not in all things which r written in tha book of tha law 2 do ’em.
But dat no man is justified by tha law in tha sight of God, it is evident: 4, tha just shall live by faith.
N tha law is not of faith: but, tha man dat does ’em shall live in ’em.
Christ has redeemed us from tha curse of tha law, bein made a curse 4 us: 4 it is written, Cursed is every one dat hangeth on a tree:
Dat tha blessing of Abraham might come on tha Gentiles through Jesus Christ; dat we might receive tha promise of tha Spirit through faith.
Brothers, I speak after tha manner of men; Though it be but a man’s covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
Now 2 Abraham N his seed were tha promises made. He says not, N 2 seeds, as of many; but as of one, N 2 ur seed, which is Christ.
N dis I say, dat tha covenant, dat was confirmed before of God in Christ, tha law, which was four hundred N thirty years after, cannot disannul, dat it should make tha promise of none effect.
4 if tha inheritance be of tha law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it 2 Abraham by promise.
So then serves tha law? It was added because of transgressions, till tha seed should come 2 whom tha promise was made; N it was ordained by angels in tha hand of a mediator.
Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
Is tha law then against tha promises of God? God forbid: 4 if there had been a law given which could have given life, for real righteousness should have been by tha law.
But tha scripture has concluded all under sin, dat tha promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given 2 ’em dat believe.
But before faith came, we were kept under tha law, shut up 2 tha faith which should afterwards be revealed.
So tha law was our schoolmaster 2 bring us 2 Christ, dat we might be justified by faith.
But after dat faith is come, we r no longer under a schoolmaster.
4 y’all r all tha children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
4 as many of u as have been baptized in2 Christ have put on Christ.
There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: 4 y’all r all one in Christ Jesus.
N if y’all be Christ’s, then r y’all Abraham’s seed, N heirs according 2 tha promise.

4.text: Now I say, dat tha heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
But is under tutors N governors until tha time appointed of tha father.
Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under tha elements of tha world:
But when tha fulness of tha time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under tha law,
2 redeem ’em dat were under tha law, dat we might receive tha adoption of sons.
N because y’all r sons, God has sent forth tha Spirit of his Son in2 ur hearts, cryin, Abba, Father.
So u r no more a servant, but a son; N if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
But then, when y’all knew not God, y’all did service 2 ’em which by nature r no gods.
But now, after dat y’all have known God, or rather r known of God, how turn y’all again 2 tha weak N beggarly elements, whereunto y’all desire again 2 be in bondage?
y’all observe days, N months, N times, N years.
I am afraid of u, lest I have bestowed upon u labour in vain.
Brothers, I beg u, be as I am; 4 I am as y’all r: y’all have not injured me at all.
y’all know how through infirmity of tha flesh I preached tha gospel 2 u at tha first.
N my temptation which was in my flesh y’all despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
Where is then tha blessedness y’all spoke of? 4 I bear u record, dat, if it had been possible, y’all would have plucked out ur own eyes, N have given ’em 2 me.
Am I therefore become ur opp, because I tell u tha truth?
Dey zealously affect u, but not well; yeah, dey would exclude u, dat y’all might affect ’em.
But it is good 2 be zealously affected always in a good thing, N not only when I am present wit u.
My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in u,
I desire 2 be present wit u now, N 2 change my voice; 4 I stand in doubt of u.
Tell me, y’all dat desire 2 be under tha law, do y’all not hear tha law?
4 it is written, dat Abraham had two sons, tha one by a bondmaid, tha other by a freewoman.
But he who was of tha bondwoman was born after tha flesh; but he of tha freewoman was by promise.
Which things r an allegory: 4 dese r tha two covenants; tha one from tha mount Sinai, which gendereth 2 bondage, which is Agar.
4 dis Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, N answers 2 Jerusalem which now is, N is in bondage wit her children.
But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is tha mother of us all.
4 it is written, Rejoice, u barren dat bear not; break forth N cry, u dat travail not: 4 tha desolate has many more children than she which has an husband.
Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, r tha children of promise.
But as then he dat was born after tha flesh persecuted him dat was born after tha Spirit, even so it is now.
Nevertheless what says tha scripture? Cast out tha bondwoman N her son: 4 tha son of tha bondwoman shall not be heir wit tha son of tha freewoman.
So then, brothers, we r not children of tha bondwoman, but of tha free.

5.text: Stand fast therefore in tha liberty wherewith Christ has made us free, N don’t be entangled again wit tha yoke of bondage.
Look, I Paul say 2 u, dat if y’all be circumcised, Christ shall profit u nothing.
4 I testify again 2 every man dat is circumcised, dat he is a debtor 2 do tha whole law.
Christ is become of no effect 2 u, whoever of u r justified by tha law; y’all r fallen from grace.
4 we through tha Spirit wait 4 tha hope of righteousness by faith.
4 in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which works by love.
y’all did run well; who did hinder u dat y’all should not obey tha truth?
Dis persuasion comes not of him dat calls u.
A little leaven leaveneth tha whole lump.
I have confidence in u through tha Lord, dat y’all will be none otherwise minded: but he dat troubles u shall bear his judgment, whoever he be.
N I, brothers, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is tha offence of tha cross ceased.
I would dey were even cut off which trouble u.
4, brothers, y’all have been called 2 liberty; only use not liberty 4 an occasion 2 tha flesh, but by love serve one another.
4 all tha law is fulfilled in one word, even in dis; u will love ur neighbour as urself.
But if y’all bite N devour one another, pay attention dat y’all don’t be consumed one of another.
Dis I say then, Walk in tha Spirit, N y’all shall not fulfil tha lust of tha flesh.
4 tha flesh lusteth against tha Spirit, N tha Spirit against tha flesh: N dese r contrary tha one 2 tha other: so dat y’all cannot do tha things dat y’all would.
But if y’all be led of tha Spirit, y’all r not under tha law.
Now tha works of tha flesh r manifest, which r dese; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, N such like: of tha which I tell u before, as I have also told u in time past, dat dey which do such things shall not inherit tha kingdom of God.
But tha fruit of tha Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
N dey dat r Christ’s have crucified tha flesh wit tha affections N lusts.
If we live in tha Spirit, let us also walk in tha Spirit.
Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

6.text: Brothers, if a man be overtaken in a fault, y’all which r spiritual, restore such an one in tha spirit of meekness; considering urself, lest u also be tempted.
Bear y’all one another’s burdens, N so fulfil tha law of Christ.
4 if a man think himself 2 be something, when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
But let every man prove his own work, N then shall he have rejoicin in himself alone, N not in another.
4 every man shall bear his own burden.
Let him dat is taught in tha word communicate 2 him dat teaches in all good things.
Don’t be deceived; God is not mocked: 4 whatever a man sows, dat shall he also reap.
4 he dat sows 2 his flesh shall of tha flesh reap corruption; but he dat sows 2 tha Spirit shall of tha Spirit reap life everlasting.
N let us not be weary in well doin: 4 in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good 2 all men, especially 2 ’em who r of tha household of faith.
y’all see how large a letter I have written 2 u wit my own hand.
As many as desire 2 make a fair show in tha flesh, dey constrain u 2 be circumcised; only lest dey should suffer persecution 4 tha cross of Christ.
4 neither dey themselves who r circumcised keep tha law; but desire 2 have u circumcised, dat dey may glory in ur flesh.
But God forbid dat I should glory, save in tha cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom tha world is crucified 2 me, N I 2 tha world.
4 in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
N as many as walk according 2 dis rule, peace be on ’em, N mercy, N upon tha Israel of God.
From from now on let no man trouble me: 4 I bear in my body tha marks of tha Lord Jesus.
Brothers, tha grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be wit ur spirit. Amen.
